newsitem.title: INDIA: India 96/97 wheat output seen at 64.5 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: India 96/97 wheat output seen at 64.5 mln tonnes.

text.p: Indian wheat production is estimated to rise to 64.5 million tonnes in 1996/97 (June-May) from 62.62 million in the previous period, the Agriculture Ministry said in a statement on Wednesday.
Indian oilseeds production is estimated to rise to 24.11 million tonnes in 1996/97 from 22.42 million in the previous period, the ministry said.
Cotton production is estimated to rise to 14.3 million bales from 13.09 million.
Rice production is estimated steady at 79.63 million tonnes in 1996/97, compared with 79.62 million in the previous period.
Foodgrains production is estimated to rise to 191.18 million tonnes in 1996/97 from 185.04 million in the previous period, the Agriculture Ministry added.
